definitions: The streaking or smearing of moving objects in a photograph or video, caused by the object's movement during the exposure time.
A visual effect in animation or video games that simulates the streaking of moving objects to enhance the perception of speed or fluidity.
examples: The photographer used a slow shutter speed to create intentional motion blur.
Excessive motion blur can make an image appear out of focus.
The game engine applied motion blur to fast-moving vehicles.
